Replace the synchronous generation with: ```python if not bank_questions: # Create quiz with pending seed status quiz = Quiz( unit_id=unit.id, # adjust fields to match what Quiz actually requires tier=scope.tier, seed_status="pending", ) db.add(quiz) db.commit() from app.worker import generate_quiz_seed_task await generate_quiz_seed_task.defer_async( quiz_id=quiz.id, topic_ids=topic_ids, # list of int topic IDs in scope user_id=user_id, ) return RedirectResponse( url=f"/courses/{slug}/quiz/{quiz.id}/loading", status_code=303, ) ``` **Important:** Read the actual quiz creation code carefully.
